policy: Exact task-private compiler/scratch prefixes are replaced in command/diagnostic metadata and imported-core origin.span/origin.call_site strings inside semantic display packets. Public packet copies are not the accepted raw bytes. Source files, caller requests, MIR operations, statuses and native values are unchanged. Original stream/output hash fields remain original hashes. Raw originals remain in owned scratch. No consumer fields are exempted; replay restores the declared prefix or produces fresh actual local data.
